scene.prompt_en: Cartoon illustration, 16:9, bright flat colors, no text, no numbers. A riverside pottery yard. Center, large: a pink flamingo potter with round glasses, a clay-stained apron and human arms, standing on one leg. In each hand it holds a small house-shaped teapot, one with a straw thatched roof, one with a big yellow star on its roof, pouring both at once into a huge striped jar. Fresh green herbs burst upward out of the jar; a gold medal hangs on the jar. A bunch of pink zinnias is tucked behind its elbow. Upper left, a kite shaped like a dried pollock fish; its string is tied to the flamingo's raised leg. A white sheep presses against its foot. Few objects, all large.

T1.reverse_q: 神農本草經 365종에 名醫別錄 365종을 합쳐 730종으로 엮은 梁의 '本草中興의 祖'와 그 책은? (明 아님 · 本草拾遺는 唐 陳藏器)

scene.prompt_en: Cartoon illustration, 16:9, bright colors, no text, no numbers. Inside a candy shop. Center, large: a king in a gold crown sits on top of a gigantic bowl of Korean shaved ice piled with colorful candies. His left hand presses a sticky note onto a huge open yellow book on a stand, already covered with sticky notes. A thick bright-blue block of extra pages is attached to the book's side; a turkey stands on it holding a windsock flag. On the king's knee rests a black sphere as big as a beach ball; his right hand turns a large golden key in it and it cracks open. A small bearded old sage rises from it, a flame in one hand, a ball of water in the other.

scene.prompt_en: Cartoon illustration, 16:9, bright colors, no text, no numbers. Background upper left: a Korean thatched lookout hut on wooden stilts in a melon field. Foreground center, large: a mole sitting on a thick gnarled tree root at the mouth of its burrow. With both paws it pulls a big round golden hand mirror out of the soil. The mirror's handle is a rotten, moldy cucumber split open to show its seeds. The mole sticks its tongue far out at the mirror, the tongue reflected in it, a glass thermometer lying on the tongue. A gold medal hangs from the mirror's rim. Simple background, objects large.

T3.reverse_q: 舌象 36종을 실은 최초의 舌診 전문서와 그 저자·왕조는? (28 · 33은 누구의 무엇?)

scene.prompt_en: Cartoon, 16:9, bright colors, no text, no numbers. A stone staircase rising left to right. Bottom step, pink azaleas: a small armored bird with an ear of wheat in its beak. Second step: twin bronze men carry a big full moon between them, under a door frame with a pine branch on the lintel. Past the door, pine twigs stick out under the threshold onto a wide flat landing. On the landing, side by side at the same height: a man frowning in concentration gripping a ruler by its middle, a green sprout on the ruler, other hand spread open; and a weeping willow with a face, bawling, on a tiny island in its tear puddle, red lanterns on its branches. Top step, a bit higher: a white duck bowing to a golden go board, a clear glass door behind.

T4.numbers: 기둥 둘 + 손: 354 = 보름달(음력 한 해 12 × 29.5). 349 = 354 − 5: 새는 손(다섯 손가락)이 없다. 359 = 354 + 5: 제 손가락으로 재는(同身寸) 집중이가 손을 쫙 편다(= 360 − 1). 359 그대로: 버드나무는 통곡만 하고 안 보탬 → 같은 층계참. 361 = 바둑판 19 × 19, 두 점 더.
